verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is an equity-management SaaS platform, where a sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask about, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no sandbox, test tenant or non-production environment. Scenario modeling of hypothetical rounds is a different, in-app planning feature, not an isolated sandbox. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or developer docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
